answer: New identities enter at one jetty, one berth per epoch: a refundable bond countersigned by three established peers, who forfeit their stake if the newcomer cheats. Berth caps make flooding slow and public. Payment flows only against forge-sealed work receipts bound to hardware roots; bulk-forging is infeasible. A raven corps of auditors re-verifies sampled receipts; one failure burns the bond and all guarantor stakes. Each fake costs a bond, three guarantors at risk, and a scarce berth, while revenue stays flat — cost linear, marginal profit negative, and the sybil fleet starves at the jetty.
